title: DashboardWidgetSpec
description:
A single widget to be rendered on a REAP-native page (may be Grafana-rendered or REAP-rendered).

Security note: For `grafana_panel_iframe` widgets, REAP should only bind selector vars that are explicitly allowlisted in the Grafana catalog entry (`GrafanaCatalogEntry.vars`). Tenant identity (org_id) is derived from REAP identity (JWT/embed token), not from URL vars.

bindings.description:
Widget-type-specific bindings.

Common patterns:
- `grafana_panel_iframe`: `bindings.vars` (map of allowed selector vars like `site_id`, `target_id`) and time fields (`from`, `to`, optional `asOf`).
- `reap_native_chart`: uses `query` intent bindings.
- `topology_view`: viewKey + highlight.
- `evidence_timeline`: incidentId.

Do not include `org_id` in bindings; tenancy comes from identity.

iframeUrl.description: Relative iframe URL under the REAP domain (typically `/grafana/...`) for `grafana_panel_iframe` widgets.
